title: SEQ=256 INT10 Transformer + AXI-DMA integration for MYIR Z-Turn XC7Z020

numeric_contract.pipeline: normalize [1024,8] window -> quantize signed INT10 (round, clamp +/-511) -> exact integer 4:1 aggregation -> [256,8] transformer inference -> 4 integer logits -> argmax class
numeric_contract.aggregation: signed round-half-away-from-zero mean, factor=4: q=(|sum|+2)>>2 with sign restored, then clamp to INT10
numeric_contract.ingress_axi_stream_order: row-major [sample, channel]; word = sample*8 + channel; 1024*8 = 8192 int32 words per window; TLAST on word 8191
numeric_contract.egress: 4 int32 logits; TLAST on logit 3; class = argmax

hls_synthesis_estimates.note_estimates_only: These are HLS operator-count estimates, NOT place-and-route results. HLS estimate DSP=156, LUT=52864/53200. Vivado post-route below is authoritative for real resources.

vivado_post_route.system: Zynq PS7 + AXI DMA (MM2S+S2MM, 32-bit) + AXI interconnect (HP0) + transformer_top HLS IP, 100 MHz FCLK0

dsp_margin.reason: The transformer_top IP OOC synthesis is constrained with synth_design -max_dsp 210 so ten DSP48E1 sites remain free at the implemented-system level. HLS operator estimates count multipliers, but Vivado can expand wide multipliers into extra DSP48 primitives during synthesis; the limit makes the margin real rather than an HLS estimate.

cost_of_margin.note: Measured, not zero. The DSP-margin build uses a revised HLS core (Q40 arithmetic + token-buffer reuse), so its scheduled latency is +1,522 cycles (+0.01522 ms at 100 MHz, ~+0.1022%) vs the earlier 220-DSP integrated build (1,489,004 cyc). This DMA16 rebuild keeps that core and changes only the DMA length capability; post-route resources are +842 LUT and +318 FF versus the earlier 220-DSP system, setup slack is +0.364 ns, BRAM is unchanged, and routing has 0 errors.

realtime_assessment.note: Computational real-time condition (compute < acquisition period) is met at the 100 MHz target clock, based on the HLS scheduled interval and Vivado post-route timing closure. This is NOT a live/measured on-board throughput.

limitations: The selected target is the MYIR Z-Turn MYS-7Z020-C-S with XC7Z020-1CLG400C.
